* /mcp.notes: The mounted MCP service dispatches POST JSON RPC (application/json), GET observation and DELETE session requests. Authenticate the complete mount and retain the execution fence; unsupported methods/paths must fail.

POST /internal/skill-maintenance/{action.notes: Workload proof supplements the signed ticket and execution fence. The prepare action is a bounded multipart artifact upload; other actions are strict application/json controls.

POST /internal/skill-temporary/{action}.notes: Workload proof supplements the signed ticket and execution fence. The install action is a bounded multipart artifact upload; release is a strict application/json control.

* /mcp/{path...}.notes: The mounted MCP service dispatches POST JSON RPC (application/json), GET observation and DELETE session requests. Authenticate the complete mount and retain the execution fence; unsupported methods/paths must fail.

GET /status/live.notes: Identity-free status only. All callers may probe this reduced liveness route; it grants no Runtime execution or binding authority.

HEAD /status/live.notes: Identity-free status only. All callers may probe this reduced liveness route; it grants no Runtime execution or binding authority.
